title: Picnic
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother George.
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治。

lines.en: This is Mommy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈。这就是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig.
lines.zh: 小猪佩奇。

lines.en: Picnic.
lines.zh: 野餐。

lines.en: It is a lovely bright sunny day. Peppa and her family are going for a picnic.
lines.zh: 这是一个阳光灿烂的美好日子。佩奇和她的家人要去野餐。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is bringing the picnic basket.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸带来了野餐篮。

lines.en: Picnic blanket, bread, cheese, tomatoes and lemonade.
lines.zh: 野餐毯、面包、奶酪、西红柿和柠檬水。

lines.en: Is there anything we've forgotten?
lines.zh: 有什么我们忘记的吗？

lines.en: Mommy's strawberry cake.
lines.zh: 妈妈的草莓蛋糕。

lines.en: I was just teasing. Mommy's homemade strawberry cake is there too.
lines.zh: 我只是在开玩笑。妈妈自制的草莓蛋糕也在那里。

lines.en: Is everybody ready?
lines.zh: 大家准备好了吗？

lines.en: Ready!
lines.zh: 准备好了！

lines.en: Then let's go!
lines.zh: 那我们走吧！

lines.en: This looks like just the spot for our picnic.
lines.zh: 这看起来就是我们野餐的地方。

lines.en: It's great to be outdoors. We should run around a bit and get some exercise.
lines.zh: 在户外真是太好了。我们应该出去跑一跑，锻炼一下身体。

lines.en: I want to eat then have a nap. I certainly don't want to run around.
lines.zh: 我想吃饭然后睡午觉。我当然不想到处乱跑。

lines.en: Maybe Daddy should run around a bit. His tummy is quite big.
lines.zh: 也许爸爸应该跑一跑。他的肚子相当大。

lines.en: My tummy is not big. But later I will get some exercise even if no one else does.
lines.zh: 我的肚子不大。但以后即使没有人做，我也会做一些锻炼。

lines.en: Let's eat.
lines.zh: 我们吃饭吧。

lines.en: Good idea, Mommy Pig. I'm really hungry.
lines.zh: 好主意，猪妈妈。我真的很饿。

lines.en: Delicious!
lines.zh: 好吃！

lines.en: I feel quite sleepy.
lines.zh: 我感觉很困。

lines.en: I thought you wanted to run around a bit, Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我以为你想跑一跑，猪爸爸。

lines.en: Later.
lines.zh: 稍后。

lines.en: Look, there's a little duck pond.
lines.zh: 看，有一个小鸭池。

lines.en: Mummy, can we feed the ducks?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我们可以喂鸭子吗？

lines.en: Yes, you can feed them the rest of the bread.
lines.zh: 是的，你可以把剩下的面包喂给他们。

lines.en: Peppa and George love feeding bread to ducks.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢给鸭子喂面包。

lines.en: Mummy, I think they want some more.
lines.zh: 妈妈，我想他们还想要更多。

lines.en: That was the last of the bread. I'm sure they've had enough.
lines.zh: 那是最后一块面包了。我确信他们已经受够了。

lines.en: Sorry, Mrs Duck. We've no more bread.
lines.zh: 对不起，鸭太太。我们没有面包了。

lines.en: The ducks want more food.
lines.zh: 鸭子想要更多食物。

lines.en: So much for Daddy Pig and his exercise.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸和他的锻炼就到此为止了。

lines.en: Eh? What?
lines.zh: 呃？什么？

lines.en: You lot again? Peppa told you, there's no more bread.
lines.zh: 你们又来了吗？佩奇告诉你，没有面包了。

lines.en: Mummy, we do have strawberry cake.
lines.zh: 妈妈，我们有草莓蛋糕。

lines.en: Well, if there's any cake left over, you can give it to the ducks.
lines.zh: 好吧，如果还有剩下的蛋糕，你可以把它送给鸭子。

lines.en: Everyone likes Mummy Pig's homemade strawberry cake.
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢猪妈妈自制的草莓蛋糕。

lines.en: Ooh, a wasp! I hate wasps. Shoo!
lines.zh: 噢，一只黄蜂！我讨厌黄蜂。嘘！

lines.en: What a fuss, Mummy Pig. It's only a little wasp.
lines.zh: 真是大惊小怪，猪妈妈。这只是一只小黄蜂。

lines.en: Go away, wasp!
lines.zh: 走开，黄蜂！

lines.en: Just stay still, Mummy Pig, then it will fly away.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈，别动，它就会飞走。

lines.en: There, you see? All you had to do was stay still.
lines.zh: 在那里，你看到了吗？你所要做的就是保持静止。

lines.en: Eh? Get away! Scram!
lines.zh: 呃？逃离！滚！

lines.en: Whoa! Help! Whoa! Shoo! Get it off me!
lines.zh: 哇！帮助！哇！嘘！把它从我身上拿开！

lines.en: I hope the wasp doesn't sting, Daddy.
lines.zh: 我希望黄蜂不会蜇人，爸爸。

lines.en: Oh, get away, you little pest!
lines.zh: 哦，走开，你这个小害虫！

lines.en: No, Daddy Pig is running too fast for the wasp to catch him.
lines.zh: 不行，猪爸爸跑得太快了，黄蜂追不上他。

lines.en: Let's eat our cake before the wasp comes back.
lines.zh: 让我们在黄蜂回来之前吃掉我们的蛋糕吧。

lines.en: Oh, no, we forgot to leave any for the ducks.
lines.zh: 哦，不，我们忘了给鸭子留一些。

lines.en: I think I lost it.
lines.zh: 我想我把它弄丢了。

lines.en: You said you would run around and get some exercise, Daddy Pig,
lines.zh: 你说要跑来跑去锻炼身体的猪爸爸，

lines.en: but I didn't believe you'd do it.
lines.zh: 但我不相信你会这么做。

lines.en: Luckily, I managed to hang on to my slice of strawberry cake.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，我设法保住了我的那片草莓蛋糕。

lines.en: Stop, Daddy! We promised the rest of the cake for the ducks.
lines.zh: 停下来，爸爸！我们答应把剩下的蛋糕给鸭子。

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: You are very lucky, ducks.
lines.zh: 你们很幸运，鸭子。

lines.en: Say thank you to Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 向猪爸爸表示感谢。

lines.en: You're most welcome.
lines.zh: 不客气。

lines.en: It's time to go home. Say goodbye to the ducks.
lines.zh: 该回家了。和鸭子说再见。

lines.en: Bye-bye, ducks.
lines.zh: 再见，鸭子们。

lines.en: See you next time.
lines.zh: 下次见。

lines.en: Peppa Pig
lines.zh: 小猪佩奇
